_comment: Template for `claude mcp add --scope user`. 'playwright' mirrors the server actually found in ~/.claude.json. chrome-devtools/firecrawl/perplexity/omniroute are scaffolding entries (not present in the original config when this template was generated) — verify package names and env vars before running the install scripts, then delete this note. 'omniroute' additionally requires `npm install -g omniroute` first (the MCP server talks to the local OmniRoute gateway at http://localhost:20128).
